title: Choose the new Look Sideways visual world
question: All three preserve the research model and replace the released dashboard grammar. Choose one system to carry across every public surface, steer a hybrid, or re-roll.

options.label: Comparison Light Table
options.lineage: Photographic light boxes, acetate overlays, and forensic registration sheets
options.body: The product becomes a place where incomplete paths are physically aligned and their mismatch stays visible. Strongest connection to the name and comparison mechanism; risk is looking clinical unless profiles retain human narrative.

options.label: Field Atlas
options.lineage: Geological surveys, route maps, field editions, and evidence legends
options.body: The dataset becomes terrain: starts, leverage, sequence, and luck read as separate route layers. Clearest publication system and easiest to extend; risk is making individual lives feel too geographic or abstract.

options.label: Documentary Cut Room
options.lineage: Contact sheets, timecode, edit benches, and visible sequence splices
options.body: Biography becomes the final edit, with missing footage and alternate takes made explicit. Strongest storytelling system; risk is preserving too much dark-screen atmosphere from the rejected surface.
